description: Runs a Bluetooth DTM receiver test over the top toolbar Target DUT Control Port connection and judges the packet error rate (PER).
help_text:
📡 [Bluetooth DTM RX Test]

1. Setup: Configure the Target DUT Control Port in the top Hardware Connection toolbar (DTM standard baudrate: 19200 bps)
2. Companion TX Port (Optional): A second DTM device on this host. If set, this card automatically starts transmission on the same channel before measuring PER.
   Leave empty to control no transmitter - an external signal source must be active, or PER will be 100%.
3. Payload & PHY: Must match the transmitter's settings so the expected packet count is accurately calculated
4. Verdict: Measured PER <= Max Allowed Packet Error Rate (default 30.0%)
5. For RX current draw measurement, use 'PPK2 DTM RX Current'
name: Bluetooth DTM RX Test
